title: Semantic Kernel Basics
description: Get started with Microsoft Semantic Kernel for building AI-powered applications.

data.text: Semantic Kernel is Microsoft's SDK for building AI applications. It provides kernels, skills, and connectors for orchestrating AI workflows.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Semantic Kernel provides a structured way to build AI applications. Use kernels to orchestrate skills and connectors to integrate with LLM providers.
